_note: Curated building blocks the brief engine combines: base pieces (a simple, sleek starting point), signature details (the one small detail that makes a piece special), materials and colourways. The engine decides which combinations to recommend from trend, brand and sales evidence; it never copies a past product.

organic-cotton-jersey.label: organic cotton jersey
organic-cotton-jersey.note: Organic cotton, grown without synthetic pesticides or fertilisers.

lyocell-jersey.label: lyocell jersey
lyocell-jersey.note: Lyocell from certified wood pulp, made in a closed-loop process that recovers its solvent.

organic-crinkle-cotton.label: organic crinkled cotton
organic-crinkle-cotton.note: Organic cotton with a permanent crinkle finish, so it needs no ironing.

organic-cotton-poplin.label: organic cotton poplin
organic-cotton-poplin.note: Organic cotton, grown without synthetic pesticides or fertilisers.

recycled-satin.label: recycled polyester satin
recycled-satin.note: Satin woven from recycled polyester made from post-consumer plastic bottles.

organic-rib-knit.label: organic cotton rib knit
organic-rib-knit.note: Organic cotton rib with a small share of elastane for recovery.

recycled-denim.label: denim with recycled cotton
recycled-denim.note: Blends cotton recycled from post-consumer denim with new fibre.

organic-cotton-denim.label: organic cotton denim
organic-cotton-denim.note: Organic cotton denim finished with a low-water wash.

bases.name: Multiway jersey midi dress
bases.description: A fitted-bodice midi dress in {material} with two long, wide straps that wrap and tie, so one dress can be styled several ways.
bases.targetCustomer: Event-to-everyday dresser, 20–35, who wants one dress for weddings, dinners and holidays

steps: Bring both straps over the shoulders from the front.
Cross them at the back.
Wrap them once around the waist and tie at the front.
Take one strap diagonally over the opposite shoulder.
Wrap the second strap around the waist as a belt.
Tie both ends together at the side seam.
Wrap both straps around the bust, crossing them at the back.
Bring them round to the front.
Knot them at the waist.

bases.name: Two-piece shirt dress
bases.description: A relaxed shirt dress in {material} with a low drop-waist seam that hides a row of buttons, so the bodice and skirt come apart.
bases.targetCustomer: Student or young professional, 18–30, building a capsule wardrobe on a budget

steps: Undo the hidden button placket along the drop-waist seam.
Wear the bodice as a cropped shirt, open or knotted.
Wear the skirt on its own; it has its own finished waistband.
Unbutton the front placket fully.
Wear it open over jeans or a slip dress as a light layer.

bases.name: Bias-cut slip dress
bases.description: A bias-cut midi slip dress in {material} with fine adjustable straps and a straight neckline that skims the body.
bases.targetCustomer: Going-out dresser, 20–35, who layers it by day and dresses it up at night

bases.name: Drop-waist jersey midi dress
bases.description: A soft midi dress in {material} with a long fitted bodice, a low drop waist and a gently flared skirt.
bases.targetCustomer: Everyday comfort dresser, 22–40, who wants a dress that works with trainers

bases.name: Layered column dress
bases.description: A column midi dress with a removable {material} overlay worn over a matching opaque slip.
bases.targetCustomer: Trend-led dresser, 18–28, who likes statement layering

steps: Undo the two snaps hidden at the shoulders.
Lift the sheer overlay off over the head.
Wear the overlay on its own over jeans and a fitted tank.
Tie the side ribbons loosely to shape the waist.

bases.name: Scarf-collar blouse
bases.description: A relaxed blouse in {material} with long scarf ends at the collar that tie, knot or hang loose.
bases.targetCustomer: Workwear-to-weekend dresser, 22–40, who wants polished pieces that aren't stiff

steps: Untie the bow.
Tuck the scarf ends inside the collar for a clean V-neck.
Wear the blouse back to front, so the button placket becomes a low back.
Tie the scarf ends at the nape of the neck.

bases.name: Two-way rib top
bases.description: A fitted top in {material}, cut to be worn with a V-neck at the front or turned around for a scoop neck with a V-back.
bases.targetCustomer: Casual everyday dresser, 18–30, who buys basics with a twist

steps: Take the top off and turn it around.
Wear the scoop side at the front so the V sits at the back.

bases.name: Sheer button-up shirt
bases.description: An oversized button-up shirt in {material}, made to layer over a bandeau, a slip dress or a fitted tank.
bases.targetCustomer: Festival and city dresser, 18–28, who likes layering

bases.name: On/off-shoulder top
bases.description: A loose top in {material} with an elasticated neckline and a drawcord hem.

steps: Pull the elasticated neckline down over both shoulders.
Spread the gathers evenly across the front.
Pull the hem drawcord to gather the top into a cropped shape.
Tie the drawcord in a bow at the front.

bases.name: Barrel-leg jeans
bases.description: Mid-rise barrel-leg jeans in {material} with a rounded leg that tapers to a cropped hem.
bases.targetCustomer: Denim-first casual dresser, 18–30, who follows new fits

bases.name: Zip-off wide-leg jeans
bases.description: Wide-leg jeans in {material} with a zip concealed in a seam above the knee, so the lower legs come off and the jeans become long shorts.
bases.targetCustomer: Student or traveller, 18–30, packing light for changing weather

steps: Open the zip hidden in the seam above each knee.
Remove both lower legs; the zip tape is finished to sit flat as a hem.
Line up each lower leg using the matching seam markers.
Close both zips; the seam reads as a design line.

bases.name: Jeans-to-skirt convertible
bases.description: Straight-leg jeans in {material} with zips along both inner leg seams and a hidden denim panel, so the jeans open into a midi skirt.
bases.targetCustomer: Statement-casual dresser, 18–28, who likes pieces with a story

steps: Unzip both inner leg seams from hem to crotch.
Unfold the panel tucked inside the back seam.
Snap it across the front opening to close the skirt.
Unsnap the front panel and tuck it back inside.
Wear the skirt with an open front split.

bases.name: High-rise straight-leg jeans
bases.description: High-rise straight-leg jeans in {material} with a clean front, a long inseam and a pressed centre crease.
bases.targetCustomer: Smart-casual dresser, 22–40, who wears jeans to work

bases.name: Convertible tube skirt
bases.description: A midi tube skirt in {material} with a deep, soft elastic waistband that stretches up over the bust.
bases.targetCustomer: Casual and holiday dresser, 18–30, who packs light

steps: Pull the waistband up so it sits over the bust.
Smooth the skirt down; the midi length now falls as a mini dress.
Push the skirt up from the hem and gather it at the hips.
The soft elastic holds the gathers in place.

bases.name: Drop-waist pleated midi skirt
bases.description: A midi skirt in {material} with a smooth hip yoke and soft pleats released from a low drop waist.
bases.targetCustomer: Polished dresser, 22–40, building outfits for work and dinners

bases.name: Multiway wrap skirt
bases.description: A long wrap skirt in {material} with extra-long waist ties, cut wide enough to wear as a halter dress.
bases.targetCustomer: Holiday and occasion dresser, 20–35, who wants one piece to pack

steps: Wrap the skirt around the body just under the arms.
Cross the long ties at the front.
Tie them behind the neck.
Wrap the waistband around the bust.
Take the ties round the waist and knot them at the side.

bases.name: Bubble-hem mini skirt
bases.description: A mini skirt in {material} with a gathered waist and a puffed bubble hem.

bases.name: Bias-cut midi skirt
bases.description: A bias-cut midi skirt in {material} with a slim elastic waist and a fluid hem.

dress.text: A short run of exposed ribbon lacing down the centre back, finished in a soft bow at the waist. It also lets the wearer adjust the fit.

top.text: Exposed ribbon lacing at the centre back, from the shoulder blades to the waist, that pulls in for a closer fit.

skirt.text: Exposed ribbon lacing at the centre-back waist that doubles as fit adjustment, finished with a small bow.

jeans.text: Exposed lacing across the back yoke in place of a belt, so the waist can be tightened by hand.

dress.text: A narrow self-fabric scarf set into the neckline, long enough to tie as a bow, a knot or a loose drape.

top.text: A narrow self-fabric scarf set into the neckline, long enough to tie as a bow, a knot or a loose drape.

skirt.text: A narrow self-fabric scarf threaded through the waistband and tied off to one side as a sash.

jeans.text: A slim cotton scarf threaded through the belt loops in place of a belt, knotted at the hip.

dress.text: Shoulder straps that tie in small bows at the front, so the strap length and neckline height can be adjusted.
A single sheer inset across the upper back in tonal mesh, keeping the front clean.

top.text: Sheer sleeves in tonal mesh on an otherwise opaque body.

skirt.text: A deep band of tonal mesh at the hem, so the skirt reads midi but feels light.

dress.text: One oversized sculpted button at the neckline, the only fastening on show.

top.text: One oversized sculpted button at the neckline, the only fastening on show.

skirt.text: One oversized sculpted button at the side waist, fastening an overlapped panel.

jeans.text: A single oversized sculpted shank button at the waist in brushed metal.
Heavy topstitching a few shades lighter than the base, tracing every seam to show off the cut.
Two seams that curve from hip to knee, shaping the leg without stretch.

dress.text: A drawcord inside one side seam that ruches the fabric, so the hem can be raised or lowered.

top.text: A drawcord inside one side seam that ruches the body into a cropped, asymmetric line.

skirt.text: A drawcord inside one side seam that ruches the fabric, so the hem can be raised or lowered.
